probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent, wherein __the thermally conductive binder is a premixed solder paste__.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to the electronic component surface by the thermally conductive binder to form boiling nucleation sites__.

3. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder is melted to affix the cavity-generating particles__.
